title: Solar Kontiki Lounge
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Get ready for a short and sweet Solar Palapa Experience, the ultimate way to explore the beauty of downtown Ottawa from the water. In just 25 minutes, soak in the best views of the Ottawa River while snapping selfies and enjoying tropical vibes. Relax and soak in the stunning views of Ottawa's iconic landmarks as you drift along the water. It's a short but sweet adventure designed to help you unwind, snap a few memorable photos, and enjoy a unique perspective of the city. Glide along the river on a solar-powered floating Tiki boat. Choose from beer, wine, and handcrafted Bartesian cocktails for that extra flair. This is Ottawa’s most affordable and unique water tour.
